fusions.name: Lobtail Crush
fusions.desc: Brings your tail down on the target, dealing 34 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Breaker Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the water flat around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Full Weight Swing
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Crushing Depth
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
